description:
Ultimate Stretch Cruiser Bike for Beach and Leisure Cruising
The Micargi Bronco Pro 26" Stretch Cruiser Bike seamlessly blends style, comfort, and performance to deliver an unparalleled cycling experience for those seeking a distinctive and enjoyable ride. With its unique design and cutting-edge features, this cruiser bike is poised to redefine your cycling adventures.
Equipped with a dependable PS75A coaster brake at the front, the bike ensures smooth and efficient stopping power, enhancing safety during your rides. The 80mm front wheel contributes to stability and control, allowing you to confidently navigate various terrains with ease.
At the rear, the Tracer Beacon Pro features a robust PS95 coaster brake with a 95mm wheel, elevating overall braking performance and ensuring a secure and controlled ride. The combination of the 26" by 14G by 140H front wheel and the 24" by 14G by 140H rear wheel not only enhances the bike's distinctive appearance but also provides a smooth and comfortable ride.
Crafted with precision and meticulous attention to detail, the Tracer Beacon Pro boasts a stretched cruiser frame that not only adds a touch of elegance but also promotes a relaxed riding posture. The use of 14G spokes on both wheels enhances durability, ensuring a sturdy build capable of withstanding the demands of regular use.
Whether you're cruising down the boardwalk, exploring the neighborhood, or commuting to work, the Tracer Beacon Pro 26" Stretch Cruiser Bike is designed to turn heads while delivering a comfortable and enjoyable ride. Elevate your cycling experience with this stylish and reliable cruiser that seamlessly combines performance and aesthetics into one impressive package.
